summary: This standards-track RFC describes how to carry VP8 video, a video codec, inside RTP packets. It covers uses from low-bitrate peer-to-peer calls to high-bitrate video conferences.

eli5.summary: A video is chopped into small packets so it can travel over the internet. This explains how to cut up and label VP8 video so the other side can put it back together.

questions: how to send vp8 video over rtp
